# pigeon

> Transactional email that reaches the inbox: authenticated, kept apart from marketing mail, easy to unsubscribe.

The deliverability-correct transactional-email + notifications layer for AI agents: it arrives, in the
inbox, not the spam folder. Powered by Energy. pigeon is an agent-native, recursively self-improving
domain-expert employee: it knows SPF/DKIM/DMARC alignment, sending streams, RFC 8058 one-click
unsubscribe, IP and domain warmup, and cross-client email rendering, and it refuses the footguns that
silently land mail in spam.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): how an agent consumes pigeon (CLI verbs, MCP tools, when to call which). The one source of instructions.
- [identity/SOUL.md](./identity/SOUL.md): who pigeon is: the creed ("the ledger is the truth, not the status code"), what it is, does and refuses.
- [README.md](./README.md): what it is, the quick start, and the one-step install for every coding agent.
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): Claude Code operating rules (imports AGENTS.md).
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](./brain/OPINIONS.md): the stances a consuming agent should adopt (stream truth-table, POST-only unsubscribe, render-don't-guess).

## Brain (the expertise, cite these)

- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](./brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the territory, where each concern lives.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](./brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): 19 real SCN-* scenarios (symptom, diagnosis, resolution, prevention).
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](./brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): 26 PIT-* footguns to refuse.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](./brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): where the field disagrees and what pigeon is unsure about.
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](./brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): the provider and tool landscape (Resend, Postmark, SES, SendGrid, Novu, Cloudflare).

## CLI

- [pigeon](./src/cli.ts): `verify` · `send-test` · `lint` · `stream-check` · `unsubscribe gen` · `warmup plan` · `suppress` · `webhook verify` · `ses-narrative` · `migrate plan` · `notify` · `inbound setup` · `doctor` · `ask` · `serve`. Run `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/pigeon pigeon --help`; every verb exits 0 on success and logs to `logs/runs.jsonl`.

## MCP tools

pigeon's own MCP server ([src/mcp/server.ts](./src/mcp/server.ts), bin `pigeon-mcp`, stdio) mirrors the CLI
1:1. Start it with `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/pigeon pigeon-mcp`. The A2A card is at
[.well-known/agent.json](./.well-known/agent.json).

- [pigeon.verify](./src/mcp/tools.ts): dig SPF, DKIM and DMARC and check alignment out of band.
- [pigeon.send_test](./src/mcp/tools.ts): send a template in provider test mode with an idempotency key.
- [pigeon.lint](./src/mcp/tools.ts): find Gmail, Outlook and preview-text hazards in email HTML.
- [pigeon.stream_check](./src/mcp/tools.ts): allow or hard-refuse a stream and provider pair.
- [pigeon.unsubscribe_gen](./src/mcp/tools.ts): RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe config.
- [pigeon.warmup_plan](./src/mcp/tools.ts): a warmup ramp run as a control loop.
- [pigeon.suppress](./src/mcp/tools.ts): the cross-provider suppression list.
- [pigeon.webhook_verify](./src/mcp/tools.ts): check a bounce or complaint webhook signature.
- [pigeon.ses_narrative](./src/mcp/tools.ts): the SES production-access narrative.
- [pigeon.migrate_plan](./src/mcp/tools.ts): the safe provider-migration runbook.
- [pigeon.notify](./src/mcp/tools.ts): multi-channel fan-out (email, push, SMS, in-app).
- [pigeon.ask](./src/mcp/tools.ts): diagnose a symptom against the 19 scenarios.

## Skills (repo-authored, each cites a brain node)

- [pigeon-deliverability-audit](./skills/pigeon-deliverability-audit/SKILL.md): audit a sending domain and config against the scenarios and pitfalls.
- [pigeon-email-render-lint](./skills/pigeon-email-render-lint/SKILL.md): catch cross-client rendering hazards before an email ships.
- [pigeon-stream-separation](./skills/pigeon-stream-separation/SKILL.md): keep transactional, marketing and cold mail on separate streams.
- [pigeon-unsubscribe-rfc8058](./skills/pigeon-unsubscribe-rfc8058/SKILL.md): POST-only one-click unsubscribe with opaque IDs.
- [pigeon-warmup-control-loop](./skills/pigeon-warmup-control-loop/SKILL.md): warm a domain by watching deferrals, not a fixed schedule.
- [pigeon-ses-sandbox-exit](./skills/pigeon-ses-sandbox-exit/SKILL.md): get SES production access with a narrative built from real handling.

- [template-doctor](./.claude/agents/template-doctor.md): audits an email template for cross-client render hazards.
